handback.title: A plan's scope comes from its criteria's files
handback.summary: The worker may change only the files the criteria list, plus their tests.
handback.user_story: The worker may change exactly the files the criteria list, plus their tests, with no separate scope to keep.

acceptance_criteria.text: A plan's scope is every file its criteria list, plus the tests the plan names.
acceptance_criteria.words: The plan's scope is all criteria's files plus their tests

edge_cases.case: A file two criteria both list shows once in the scope.

acceptance_criteria.text: The plan check rejects a plan that still carries a separate scope field.

edge_cases.case: An empty scope field is rejected too.
A planner following its instructions writes no scope field, so it is not rejected.

acceptance_criteria.text: The fence undoes the worker's change to any file no criterion lists.

edge_cases.case: A new file no criterion lists is removed.
A file only a non-functional requirement lists is kept.

acceptance_criteria.text: The plan check rejects a criterion that does not quote the owner's own words.
acceptance_criteria.words: Each one quotes my words, which are the spec.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The existing test already covers missing, invented and misplaced words.

test_changes.tests/test_agent.py::test_the_fence_read: The fence now reads criteria files, since plans no longer carry scope.
test_changes.tests/test_agent.py::test_a_replan_is_ju: Its sample plan drops the scope field, which the check now rejects.
test_changes.tests/test_criteria_quote_owner.py::test: Now proves 666.4, with an accepted good case beside each refusal.
test_changes.tests/test_parent_source.py::test_a_crit: Its sample plan drops the scope field, which the check now rejects.
test_changes.tests/test_parent_source.py::test_any_ot: Its sample plan drops the scope field, which the check now rejects.

answers.why: The sample plan no longer carries a scope field; all tests pass.
